Aisha (CS Lead): Quick kickoff for Acme EBR prep  exec slot is 20 mins next Tue. Need slides: health snapshot, onboarding status, renewal signal, 2-min ROI ask.
Tom (AE): I can draft the renewal signal + ask. Will pull ARR & NPS; aim for Wed EOD. @Priya can you confirm onboarding closure? :eyes:
Priya (CS): Onboarding at 95% complete. Only SSO and one data-mapping item left (ETA Thu). I'll prepare a "risks & mitigations" bullet list.
Sam (Eng): Demo note: live demo ok but we must include a recorded fallback clip for the mapping edge case. I'll record and upload.
Cara (RevOps): I'll generate a single-page health dashboard PNG and a compact renewal-impact chart. Where to upload? Drive or Confluence?
Aisha (CS Lead): Drive please, folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/Acme-EBR-2026 Use filename pattern slide_##_owner.png.
Tom (AE): Renewal slide plan: three mini-slides: 1) usage & engagement trend 2) top risk drivers 3) exec ask. Drafting Wed.
Priya (CS): I'll write onboarding closure slide with owners & dates + 1-line mitigation per risk.
Sam (Eng): Demo slide: include link to fallback clip and a note: "If live fails, play clip at 00:35". I'll upload clip to Drive by Thu noon.
Aisha (CS Lead): Action items:
- Tom: draft renewal signal slides (Due Wed EOD)
- Priya: onboarding closure + mitigations (Due Thu 10am PT)
- Sam: demo fallback clip + note (Due Thu 12pm PT)
- Cara: dashboard PNG + slide (Due Wed 5pm PT)
- Aisha: consolidate slides & run 30-min dry run Fri
Tom (AE): Can someone write a one-line "ask" for execs? I can draft copy but need leadership endorsement later.
Aisha (CS Lead): Placeholder ask for now: "Ask: approve 12-month renewal at 10% discount to secure roadmap priority." I'll get sponsor sign-off after dry run.
OpsBot: Reminder: Room reserved Tue 09:00 PT  Boardroom A. AV check 08:30.
Priya (CS): Also capturing top feedback themes from CS survey (3 bullets): onboarding docs clarity, API latency, billing cadence. I'll include verbatim quotes in appendix.
Cara (RevOps): Note: legal is iterating the renewal draft. If discount changes, RevOps needs 72hr lead to update entitlements.
Sam (Eng): Suggestion: highlight low-latency rollout in "value delivered" slide with small perf deltas.
Aisha (CS Lead): Plan: Wed 11am PT quick slide-turn check-in, Fri 2pm PT dry run (30m). If you can't make dry run, upload notes and flag questions here.
Tom (AE): Marked. Will upload my draft Wed EOD and ping channel. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): Noted. I'll add mitigation owners inline and ping infra for mapping ETA.
Cara (RevOps): Uploaded dashboard PNG: https://drive.redwood.ai/Acme-EBR-2026/dashboard_v1.png
Aisha (CS Lead): This thread is the single source of truth for slide ownership. No off-thread edits unless reflected here. Thanks team  let's keep exec time tight. :rocket:
